messages:
jess: Heads-up — prepping quantized weights for serving: model opt-12b-v2. Need final sign-off on calibration set and whether to ship AWQ-4 vs GPTQ-4/fp8 baseline. Weights at s3://redwood-models/onboard/opt-12b-v2/quant/ (v1-awq, v1-gptq, v1-fp8)
ryan: noted. can you paste the config you used for batch_size, seq_len, and tokenizer? any tokenizer fixes needed?
jess: config:
```json
{"batch_size":8,"max_seq_len":1024,"tokenizer":"sentencepiece_v2","pad_id":0}
```
Tokenization quirk: some samples have leading BOM causing extra tokens — i fixed with strip_bom preproc in the loader.
anika: calibration set = s3://redwood-calib/opt-12b-v2/caldataset-5k.jsonl (5k prompts, mix of long/short). Ran AWQ 4-bit LLM calib with 2k samples — results:
- perplexity delta vs fp16: +0.6%
- winrate (human eval subset): 98/100 vs fp16
ben: GPTQ-4 quantization (topk calibration) with same 5k set: perplexity +1.2%, winrate 95/100. FP8 perf same as fp16.
ryan: latency numbers on p4d for inference? any memory regressions?
jess: AWQ weights size: 6.7GB, GPTQ: 7.4GB, fp8: 8.9GB. Single-request p95 token latency:
- fp16: 45ms
- fp8: 48ms
- AWQ: 50ms
- GPTQ: 52ms
anika: cost-wise AWQ looks best and accuracy hit minimal. Concern: AWQ fallback path for KV-cache needs small runtime change (patch in PR #3421). Could we keep both variants behind rollout flag?
ben: +1 to rollout flag, need to test canary on Dedicated. Also request: include eval prompts for safety/ tox checks — add extra 500 safety prompts.
jess: PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/3421
ryan: I'll add canary route and run 100 qps smoke with both variants tomorrow. @anika can you attach the human eval set and quick eval script?
anika: attached in PR comments. script:
```bash
python eval.py --model weights/awq --prompts s3://.../human_eval.jsonl --out out_awq.json
```
jess: ok marking for approval: AWQ v1 for hosted beta, GPTQ v1 kept as fallback, FP8 for internal only. Approvers: @ryan, @ben. Please reply with :+1: to approve.
ben: :+1:
ryan: :+1: will monitor canary and revert if delta >1.5% or latency p95 > +10ms
infra-bot: deploy-schedule created for canary route: /canary/opt-12b-v2/awq at 2026-03-18T10:00Z
jess: thanks team — merging PR after infra smoke. will post rollout notes in #eng-releases.
